Even a feather! [pause] Gravity pulls light things down too. The feather falls slowly, because the air pushes up on it a little.
Magnets pull without touching too. [pause] A magnet pulls a steel paperclip through the air — and even through paper! [pause] But only some metals, like iron and steel. Not crayons, not everything.
A magnet has two ends, called N and S. [pause] Different ends snap together. But two <emphasis>same</emphasis> ends push each other apart — a push with no touch!
